payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation metrics used in the research, including BLEU-4 score, slot error rate, and manual evaluation metrics for informativeness and naturalness.

claims.text: The evaluation metrics used include BLEU-4 score and slot error rate (ERR).
Manual evaluation metrics include informativeness and naturalness, rated by human annotators.
Informativeness measures whether the generated utterance captures all specified information, while naturalness assesses human-like plausibility.
